zh: Vela 将连接开关、亮度与音量、音乐和快捷控制集中在浮动面板中，支持独立配色、图标主题与玻璃外观。
en: Vela brings connectivity, brightness, volume, music and quick controls together in a floating panel, with custom colors, icon themes and glass appearance.
features: 连接与电源
Connectivity and power
在连接模块内右滑切换到电源控制；长按支持的模块打开二级页面。可选用个人热点替换隔空投送按钮。
Swipe right inside Connectivity to reveal power controls. Hold supported modules to open their detailed controls. Personal Hotspot can optionally replace the AirDrop button.
亮度、音量与音乐
Brightness, volume and music
调整亮度与音量，查看音乐信息与控制播放；可使用当前封面作为音乐模块背景。
Adjust brightness and volume, view music information and control playback. Optionally use current artwork as the music module background.
电池、日历、提醒事项与天气
Battery, calendar, reminders and weather
四个信息卡片显示设备电量、近期日程、待办提醒和当前天气，轻点打开详情浮窗。日历与提醒事项只读取已授权的数据，锁屏时隐藏内容。

Four info cards show device battery levels, upcoming events, reminders and current weather. Tap one for a detail popover. Calendar and Reminders read only data you have authorized and hide their contents on the Lock Screen.
快捷指令第二页
Shortcuts on a second page
在面板空白或边缘横滑切换页面。从手机已有快捷指令中选择，系统负责执行；快捷页两列最多显示四行，更多内容上下滚动。

Swipe across blank panel space or its edge to switch pages. Choose existing shortcuts on your iPhone and let the system run them. The quick page shows two columns and up to four visible rows, with vertical scrolling for overflow.
2×1 快捷按钮（测试中）
2×1 quick buttons (Beta)
宽按钮只显示图标，可独立启用与排序；与快捷指令共用第二页，支持范围以设置中的可选项目为准。
Icon-only wide buttons can be enabled and reordered on the second page alongside shortcuts. Available actions are those offered in Settings.
配色、主题与玻璃
Colors, themes and glass
配色预设、明暗外观、自定义背景、系统图标与静态／动态图标主题均可配置。面板、模块、信息卡片、滑块与封面圆角可分别调节，内层圆角随外框同心计算。面板描边与模块描边可分别启用，粗细、颜色和透明度可调。玻璃效果默认关闭；录屏期间自动降低实时背景采样分辨率，结束后恢复。这些功能无需激活码。

Configure color presets, light and dark appearance, custom backgrounds, system icons and static or animated icon themes. Panel, module, info card, slider and artwork corner radii are adjustable separately, with concentric inner corners. Panel and module borders have independent switches and adjustable width, color and opacity. Glass is disabled by default; recording temporarily lowers live background sampling resolution and restores it afterward. These features do not require an activation code.
首次展开与功能导览
Initial expansion and feature tour
默认从左右两侧屏幕底边上滑呼出，中间保留 Home 手势，支持横屏全屏与锁屏。首次展示数量可按已启用模块自定义，二次上拉展开剩余模块。面板底部固定、底部圆角与屏幕匹配，缩小并渐隐收起；模块随手势逐层显示，开关默认开启。面板显示期间持续请求 120Hz，实际刷新率由系统决定。首次空配置提供可跳过、可重放的三步手势引导。

Open from either bottom edge by default, leaving the middle for Home, including landscape fullscreen and Lock Screen use. Customize the initial section count in enabled order and pull up again for the rest. The panel stays anchored at the bottom with screen-matched bottom corners and shrinks and fades to close. Gesture-driven staggered modules have a switch enabled by default. The visible panel requests 120Hz; iOS decides the actual refresh rate. Fresh configurations receive a skippable three-gesture tour that can be replayed in Settings.
scope_zh: 这是浮动控制中心插件，不替代锁屏通知播放器，也不提供跨 App 全局玻璃。快捷指令执行能力取决于 iOS 和指令自身；需要交互的指令可能显示系统提示或打开快捷指令 App。Vela Studio 是独立配套 App，不包含在本插件安装包中。
scope_en: This is a floating Control Center tweak. It does not replace the Lock Screen notification player or provide glass throughout other apps. Shortcut execution depends on iOS and each shortcut; interactive shortcuts may show system prompts or open the Shortcuts app. Vela Studio is a separate companion app and is not included in these packages.
install_zh: 最低部署版本为 iOS 16。按实际越狱环境选择一个包：RootHide 为 iphoneos-arm64e，Rootless 为 iphoneos-arm64，不可混装。安装后前往「设置 → Vela」配置；已有用户保存的呼出设置继续生效。
install_en: The minimum deployment target is iOS 16. Install one package matching your jailbreak: iphoneos-arm64e for RootHide, or iphoneos-arm64 for Rootless. Configure Settings → Vela after installation. Existing saved activation gestures are preserved.
status_zh: RootHide 与 Rootless 双包均包含 arm64 和 arm64e 切片，并分别构建验包。RootHide 0.4.46 已在 iOS 17.3.1 设备安装并核对实际文件，用户确认本轮修复可以使用；面板与玻璃通过 2767 项和 240 项模拟器检查。Rootless 与 iOS 16 尚未真机测试，也未进行长期稳定性或真机帧率测量。
status_en: The RootHide and Rootless packages each contain arm64 and arm64e slices and are built and inspected separately. RootHide 0.4.46 was installed and its files verified on iOS 17.3.1; the user confirmed the latest fixes work. Panel and glass fixtures passed 2,767 and 240 simulator checks. Rootless and iOS 16 remain untested on device, and long-duration stability and device frame rates have not been measured.
release_zh: 0.4.46 汇总 0.4.32 以来的更新：新增面板／模块描边，可调粗细、颜色和透明度；首次展示数量支持自定义，模块随手势逐层出现和隐藏，开关默认开启。面板底部固定，通过缩小与渐隐开合，去掉上下遮罩并调整完整模块布局。修复横屏全屏呼出、边缘跟手偏移、Home 区域误接管、打断后重入以及连续切页／展开收起时的位置跳变。补齐冷启动模块初始化和抬手最后采样，显示前刷新图标与按钮状态。录屏期间降低实时玻璃采样开销，结束后恢复；优化天气卡片布局和原生热点图标大小。面板显示期间持续请求 120Hz，实际刷新率由系统决定。
release_en: Version 0.4.46 collects the changes since 0.4.32: independent panel and module borders with adjustable width, color and opacity; a custom initial section count; and gesture-driven module reveals with a switch enabled by default. The panel stays anchored at the bottom, shrinking and fading to close, with upper and lower masks removed and layout adjusted for complete modules. Fixes cover fullscreen landscape activation, edge tracking offset, Home routing, interrupted gestures and position jumps during repeated page switches and expansion or collapse. Cold opens now create native module controllers, retain the final touch sample and refresh icons and button states before display. Recording temporarily lowers live glass sampling cost and restores full sampling afterward. Weather spacing and the native hotspot icon are refined. The visible panel requests 120Hz; iOS decides the actual refresh rate.
